fields.title: Where the number broke
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: DAU dropped by 12%. For each observation, state what it indicates.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Number of orders in product database did not change
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Drop is visible only on iOS
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Drop started exactly at midnight on the 14th
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/3: Historical data for last year changed too
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/4: Drop only in the last hour and evens out
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — product is fine, number is broken. 2 — platform issue, most likely release or SDK. 3 — sharp boundary points to schema drift or event loss, not human behavior. 4 — metric definition changed, not data. 5 — export delay, wait. Rule: check against product database first, then go top-down.
